title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scott’s PGA Tour Promotion
items.text: Sandy Scott shot a final-round 65 to win the Nationwide Children’s Hospital Championship, breaking the scoring record and earning his first 2027 PGA Tour card after overcoming a wrist injury.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Teases Return
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau posted "I'm coming home" on Instagram, hinting at a return with a viral hole-in-one challenge after a period of uncertainty.

items.headline: McIlroy Praised for Driving
items.text: Rory McIlroy is recognized as the best driver of the golf ball on the planet, setting a benchmark for what a ‘good’ golfer should achieve off the tee.
